subject: Vendor onboarding: Sable Logistics — VAT evidence and PO routing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: accounting@sablelogistics.co.za
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor onboarding: documents we need to activate PO for Sable Logistics

Hi Thabo —

Thanks for registering Sable Logistics in our vendor portal. To finish our procurement onboarding and activate the purchase order (PO) route, we need a small set of tax and banking documents so we can select the correct Redwood billing entity and apply any VAT reverse-charge or exemption rules.

Can you please provide the following items (PDFs preferred) by next Wednesday: 
- South African VAT registration certificate (if VAT-registered) or confirmation that you are a non-VAT-registered exporter
- Tax residency affidavit or equivalent (shows company jurisdiction for withholding/tax treaty purposes)
- Bank details PDF with IBAN/SWIFT or local bank details (please redact account numbers in public threads)
- Company registration number / CIPC extract

If you believe you qualify for VAT zero-rate or reverse-charge treatment, include a brief note explaining the basis (e.g., international transport services, export of goods, non-resident supplier of services) and any supporting HMRC/SARS references you rely on.

Ben, Laura — looping you in to confirm which Redwood entity should issue the PO if Sable is confirmed non-resident for VAT.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
attachments: none
From: Thabo Mokoena <thabo.m@sablelogistics.co.za>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounting@sablelogistics.co.za
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: documents we need to activate PO for Sable Logistics

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Please find attached: sable_vat_certificate.pdf (our VAT certificate), sable_bank_details_redacted.pdf (bank details with last 4 digits redacted), and sable_tax_residency_affidavit.pdf (signed).

A few notes on VAT: we are a South African-registered company and VAT-registered (VAT No. ZA123456789). For services provided to non-resident clients where the place of supply is outside South Africa (e.g., software integration and cross-border freight coordination), SARS guidance allows zero-rating in certain cases. For Redwood specifically, if Redwood is treated as a non-resident recipient and services are outside the scope of SA VAT, we expect no SA VAT to be charged. However, if Redwood requires reverse-charge handling on your side, we can accommodate with an invoice note.

Let me know if you need certified copies or apostille.

Kind regards,

Thabo Mokoena
Finance Manager | Sable Logistics
attachments: sable_vat_certificate.pdf (PDF), sable_bank_details_redacted.pdf (PDF), sable_tax_residency_affidavit.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: documents we need to activate PO for Sable Logistics

Tessa / Laura —

Thanks, Thabo — received and reviewed the PDFs. Quick summary:
- VAT cert shows active registration (ZA123456789).
- Tax residency affidavit states South African tax residency.
- Bank details are fine for cross-border wiring (SWIFT included).

Recommendation:
- Treat Sable as a standard ZA VAT-registered supplier for invoicing. For services that qualify as exported services or zero-rated supplies, Redwood Accounting will need a short supplier declaration on the invoice stating the service is exported / outside SA VAT scope.
- If Redwood will be treated as the importer of services under reverse charge, we need the Sable invoice to include: Sable VAT number, a line item 'Reverse charge: recipient to account for VAT' and reference to the relevant SARS regulation (we can annotate after procurement confirms).

Action items for PO activation:
- Tessa: confirm which Redwood entity will be the buying entity (US vs EU) — that determines invoicing currency and whether we apply reverse-charge or local VAT rules.
- Laura: once Tessa confirms, can we set up the PO under the correct entity and confirm payment terms (30 days) so finance can map the VAT treatment in the ledger?

I'll prepare a short supplier note template that Sable can add to invoices to speed things up.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Tax & Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: documents we need to activate PO for Sable Logistics

Ben — thanks for the read. Laura / finance: for this engagement the procurement request originates from our EMEA integrations team; however, the contracting and payment should come from Redwood Inference EU B.V. (NL entity) to keep VAT clean for EU/EMEA billing. That means PO should be created under the EU billing entity, and invoices will be routed to eu-payments@redwoodinference.com.

Laura — can you:
- Create PO under Redwood Inference EU B.V. (use GL code 6103)
- Verify payment terms are Net 30 and confirm whether we need to apply reverse-charge on our side (I think EU B.V. will treat this as import of services and account by reverse-charge per EU VAT rules; however Ben to confirm whether we also need any SA-specific handling)

I'll send Sable the PO once you confirm and ask them to include the supplier declaration Ben mentioned on their invoice.

Thanks,
Tessa
